entries.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Edit reference image 1, the actual supplier blank, into a premium SINGLE-CAP product photograph for OFF SHFT. Image1 is the exact garment shape, construction and colour reference. Image2 is the exact production artwork to embroider, not a background or logo to redesign. One Charcoal structured mid-profile Yupoong 6606 six-panel trucker, hard buckram front and matching dark charcoal mesh, smooth new charcoal twill WITHOUT a fake vintage wash, resting on warm light sand-coloured studio surface with a clean sand backdrop. Near-front view with a very slight three-quarter turn so the matching mesh side is visible but every letter is fully legible; entire hat and visor uncropped, centered, generous margins, square1:1 composition. Natural soft side sunlight, realistic cotton grain, seams, eyelets, visor stitching, grounded contact shadow, premium quiet leisure brand mood. Apply image2 faithfully on the front as raised foam 3D puff embroidery: exact wording first line 'FOR A', second line 'REASON.', left aligned and centered as an overall block, no extra words. Preserve image2's exact compact rounded Archivo letter shapes, open A/R/O counters, S openings, row proportions and circular final period. Physical overall artwork size117.05mm wide×47.69mm high within a149.86×50.8mm front embroidery field; do not stretch it across the entire cap width. Render warmly lit white satin lettering with one muted old-gold period; the period is the only contrasting colour. Visible rounded satin stitches and consistent raised puff, not print, patch or flat embroidery. Preserve the actual blank silhouette, mesh colour, cap colour and construction of image1. Do not age, wash or distress the structured Charcoal or Evergreen blanks. No added front logo, no slogans beyond the exact provided art, no hang tags, no props, no caption, no watermark. This is a mockup, not a manufactured sample.
